New York: A trade survey asked jewelers to name the strangest thing they'd caught an employee doing. The top answer was sleeping — and it got stranger from there.

Sleeping topped INSTORE's 2026 Big Survey, then drinking — one employee drank the back-bar vodka a little daily until it was gone.

The oddest entry: torch-soldering his own necklace while wearing it.
